text:
Alex K: Quick preflight for the NovaCorp pilot — they want streaming + function-calls with structured JSON outputs (tool responses), EU data residency, and KMS. Also pricing question: for ~20 concurrent streams, ~3k tokens/request, what do we recommend for Dedicated vs Hosted?

Maria S: I can own the security Qs (KMS / residency). Do we have a template answer for 'where data is stored' for Dedicated + Private?

Devon (SE): For the SDK side, we have a Node sample for streaming function-calls. Works with our streaming websocket and emits function call chunks. Paste snippet below.

Devon (SE): ```js
const ws = new WebSocket('wss://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream');
ws.on('open', () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'start', model:'redwood-stream-1', stream:true})));
ws.on('message', msg => {
  // messages come in parts; final function call looks like:
  // {type:'function_call', name:'extract_entities', args:{...}}
  console.log('chunk', msg.toString());
});
```

Devon (SE): For structured output, use function-calls + json-schema for validation. If you need strict typing, create a small validation hook in the SDK that rejects malformed tool payloads before returning to the app.

Raj P: On pricing: NovaCorp is asking if streaming reduces token bill compared to non-streaming. Also they asked about committed capacity numbers for ~20 concurrent users at 3k tokens each with bursts.

Devon (SE): Streaming itself doesn't change how we bill tokens; tokens are tokens. But for Dedicated, batching and KV prefix caching can reduce GPU cycles and therefore effective cost per request. For predictable latency at 20 concurrent steady streams, I'd recommend a reserved pool sized for peak concurrent sequences — roughly 2x the average concurrent model contexts. For example (very rough): 4x A100-equivalent GPUs for medium model, but we should run a small load test.

Maria S: Security notes to include in questionnaire: EU residency — customer can deploy Redwood Private in their VPC (we have on-prem options). KMS: we support customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM integrations; we can provide SOC2 section and contact for SSO/SAML. I'll attach the standard language after I confirm with infra.

Alex K: Thank you. Can someone confirm if function-calls support streaming chunked tool payloads, or does the SDK buffer until function call is complete? NovaCorp wants to start acting on partial tool args as they arrive.

Devon (SE): SDK currently emits function_call chunks as they arrive. The canonical pattern is: stream of delta events -> SDK reconstructs until you see "function_call" completed flag. But we can expose partial args if you set the flag `partial_tool_payload: true` in the request. It's an opt-in for now.

Raj P: For the commercial ask — are there standard pilot discounts for Dedicated POC (1 month)? They want a price anchor to include in procurement doc.

Maria S: Sales typically offers a small pilot credit. For Dedicated POC we can offer a time-limited reserved discount (30% off list for first month) subject to legal. I'll sync with finance and legal.

Alex K: Action items: 1) Maria to provide KMS/residency boilerplate + SOC2 link. 2) Devon to share the Node/Go snippet that enables `partial_tool_payload` and a short note on expected latency. 3) Raj to draft pilot pricing anchor (include burst handling). 4) Schedule a 30-min kickoff with NovaCorp next Tue 10am CET.

Devon (SE): Dropping Go snippet and a small perf note in #eng-ml after lunch. Also recommend we run a short load test with 20 streams x 3k tokens to validate GPU sizing.

Maria S: Boilerplate: "For Dedicated/Private deployments, customer data remains in their VPC/region. We support CMK (customer-managed keys) via major cloud KMS providers and on-prem HSM integrations. Logs and usage metadata retention controls are configurable; we can provide SOC2/ISO artifacts under NDA."

Raj P: I'll draft the price anchor and ping finance. Also want to confirm: do we need an infra escalation for EU region capacity?

Alex K: Yes — please loop in eng-infra if we need a dedicated capacity spin-up. Devon, can you confirm ETA for snippets?

Devon (SE): ETA EOD today for snippets + proposed test harness.

DeployBot: New runbook created: runbook://poc-novacorp-1792223334 (access control: sales+se+security).

Alex K: Great. I'll send the calendar invite and include this thread in the kickoff doc: https://short.link/novacorp-kickoff. :thumbsup:

Maria S: :+1: I'll prepare the questionnaire answers and post them here once done.

Raj P: Thanks team — I'll assemble the procurement anchor and loop in AM.

Devon (SE): If anyone wants to test locally, use the `--sample-args` flag in the SDK sample to simulate partial tool payloads.

Alex K: Closing the loop here — cheers everyone.
